channel.title: Energy and power generation – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Driving digital transformation across the asset lifecycle with Hexagon
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, discover how Hexagon's digital solutions transform operations, enhance efficiency, and unlock long-term value across the entire asset lifecycle.

item.title: Delivering intelligence at scale
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: As one of the secret ingredients behind some of Hexagon’s most recent innovations, Xalt is enabling Hexagon’s solutions to work seamlessly together to deliver intelligence at scale. In this episode, Johannes Maunz, Xalt’s Program Director, discusses Xalt’s creation, where they are today and what we can expect in the future.

item.title: Sustainability is a four-letter word: Why your way forward depends on data
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Learn why policy alone will fail the planet, and how Hexagon's innovation and technology will accelerate the business of sustainability. Watch as Mark White, Senior Vice President of Portfolio Strategy and Enablement at Hexagon’s Asset Lifecycle Intelligence division, shares how we can use technology to build a sustainable future.

item.title: Sustainability means industry must “do well to do good”: Letter from the CEO, Pt. 3
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: Part 3 of our series on CEO Ola Rollén’s shareholder letter with a focus on sustainability as a cornerstone of the autonomous future and our R-Evolution initiative to help pave the way.

item.title: Leader Standard Work
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Solving Problems with Technology, our hosts discuss best practices for the individual and the organisation regarding Leader Standard Work and how technology can make Leader Standard Work more useful.

item.title: The bedrock foundation for any change implementation
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Solving Problems with Technology, hear from culture innovators Corbins Electric and how they transformed their organisation's success by changing to a culture and people-first mindset as the starting point of their digital transformation journey.

item.title: Solving Problems with Technology: The impact of culture
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, Xalt Solutions hosts Chief Revenue Officer of KaiNexus, Jeff Roussel, to discuss how a company's culture can impact their ability to solve problems and develop technology solutions.

item.title: Solving Problems with Technology: Configuring the right solution
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of 'Solving Problems with Technology', we continue the discussion of digital transformation and solution design best practices, taking a deeper dive into what is needed to configure the right solution for your business.

item.title: Solving Problems with Technology: What is digital transformation?
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of "Solving Problems with Technology," Xalt Solutions' Josh Cranfill discusses digital transformation and what it really means to an organisation.

item.title: Leading an R-evolution
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: Imagine how it would feel to read news about progress instead of constant reports about the deterioration of the planet. If humanity acts now, we can get it right.
